metadata.name: European waste-management facilities (OED industrial occupancy 1151)
metadata.note: Synthetic waste-management portfolio for the industrial occupancy path. Each site carries occupancy_code=1151 (OED general industrial -> Hazus IND1), which reaches the Hazus industrial flood curves (structure 545 / contents 358). Sites are placed to carry real hazard signal on the test API: Nijmegen and Bordeaux for riverine/coastal flood, Venice for European wind (WISC 3s gust). Values and attributes are illustrative.
metadata.value_meaning: value is the STRUCTURE (building/plant) replacement value used as the platform TIV. contents_value is process equipment, machinery and stock (turbines, boilers, balers, sorting lines).
metadata.hazus_wind_type: Hazus wind specific-building-type (informational only; European wind is resolved by the platform with a generic building curve, so no structure/contents split is applied).
metadata.floor_area_m2: Gross conditioned floor area (asset attribute; available for a floor-area-scaled cooling estimate, see auxiliary_functions/cooling_model.py).
metadata.flood_location: flood uses occupancy routing to Hazus IND curves; location=Europe (occupancy drives the curve).
